data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'geras' meaning 'payment' or 'wages'. This name was given to those who worked on the land or farms. Gerfen is a strong and noble name for a baby boy. Parents who choose Gerfen usually hope their child will grow to embody farm worker, rustic and live with faith, good character and purpose.
